title: PixelKin - Title Theme (Lanterns to the Sky)
_note: The title-screen statement under the logo + New Game/Continue/Settings - the single most-heard melody in the game, so the hook is front-loaded and unmistakable. This is a deliberate GRAND, ASPIRATIONAL reorchestration of the Vesper motif (G3->C4->D4 lift, overshooting; settle), the same leitmotif the player meets again as Tinderwick's lullaby - but where the town theme is wistful gbc lullaby, the TITLE soars: snes era (8 voices, warm reverb), full major key, an aspirational I-iii-IV-V bed, a soaring pulse25 lead doubled by a warm string pad and bell sparkle, a moving sampled bass and a gentle-but-present drum groove. ~100 BPM, 4/4, 16-bar loop (~38s). Structure: A proud Vesper statement that climbs instead of settling; A' the same lifted an octave (the 'reach for the sky' peak); B an aspirational IV->V build; A'' resolves home and the final bar voice-leads on the G dominant back into the C downbeat (seamless loop). Renders on the chip engine like the rest of the score for cohesion.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: The Vesper motif made proud and rising. A: lift G3->C4->D4 then climb to G4 instead of settling low. A': the whole shape an octave up (the 'sky' peak). B: an aspirational reach over IV->V. A'': home statement, final reach up, then voice-lead down to G3 (dominant) into bar 1.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: Warm sustained string bed - real triads (snes can stack) voiced in the mid register below the lead so the harmony glows without mudding the tune. The aspirational I-iii-IV-V progression: C - Em - F - G, twice; then a IV->V build (F F G G); then home C C C - G to lead the seam.

tracks.name: sparkle
tracks._note: Music-box / starlight sparkle - sparse, used as colour, not a second tune. A few high twinkles over the 'sky' octave-up section (A'), then a rising sparkle on the final reach so the resolve glints. Silent elsewhere (silence is an instrument).

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: Punchy sampled-style root-fifth bass with octave motion - gives the title forward lift instead of a static pad. Roots track the C-Em-F-G progression; final bar lands on G (dominant) to pull the loop back to the C downbeat.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A gentle but present backbeat (this title aspires, it doesn't tiptoe): soft kick on 1 & 3, snare on 2 & 4, hats on the eighths. A crash opens each big section (the sky A', the B build, the home A''), and a small fill closes the loop seam so the repeat breathes. Each bar = 8 eighths.
